The "'''Green Ellipse'''" was the name given to a ruined [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Asation]] that was completely abandoned by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Considered to be one of Asation's three noteworthy landmarks alongside the city of [[Satikan]] and the [[Grand Hypergate]], the Green Ellipse was eons old by the Galactic War, and at the time it was forbidden even to members of the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Green Ellipse first appeared in the "Terror from Beyond" Operation in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
